zh-Hant: 每座島記住三個數字：易感者、免疫者、確診中，另外用 new[島][天] 記錄每天新增的病例，康復時直接查 new[島][d − R]。
移動要同步：先用移動前的人數把三座島要走的人數全部算好，再一起加減。病人不移動。
傳染率用的是「前一天結束時」的人口和免疫人數，所以每天結束前要先把它們記下來；前一天人口是 0 時新增是 0。
en: Track three numbers per island: susceptible, immune and sick. Also keep new[island][day] so recoveries are just new[island][d − R].
Movement is synchronous: compute every island's movers from the counts before moving, then apply all of them. Sick people do not move.
The infection rate uses the population and immune count from the end of yesterday, so save them at the end of each day. If yesterday's population was 0, there are 0 new cases.
